content: Per-app DNS+TLS automation via annotations is the standard k8s pattern: ExternalDNS watches Ingress resources and creates DNS records (Cloudflare supported natively); cert-manager watches cluster-issuer annotations and provisions Let's Encrypt certs (DNS-01 works for private apps). The user-visible contract is: add one Ingress manifest, get hostname + valid TLS automatically. Homelabs replicate this even with private-only exposure using Cloudflare DNS-01. Note: ExternalDNS has no native Mikrotik provider; webhook providers exist (community mikrotik webhook provider).
